description: This file defines the NetworkManager plugin class, which exposes network management APIs over JSON-RPC and COM-RPC, including notification handling, caching, and interface querying within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: Main plugin class managing network interfaces, notifications, and JSON-RPC methods.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Inner class handling network and connection notifications, implementing relevant interfaces.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Template class for thread-safe caching of network data such as IP addresses.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deactivated.

methods.name: PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).

methods.name: PublishToThunderAboutInternet
methods.description: Publishes internet status info to Thunder framework.
